// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/apply/arguments-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var f = $262.createRealm().global.$262.evalScript(
  'new Proxy(function() {}, { apply: function(_, __, args) { return args; } })'
);

assert.sameValue(f().constructor, Array);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/construct/arguments-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var C = $262.createRealm().global.$262.evalScript(
  'new Proxy(function() {}, { construct: function(_, args) { return args; } })'
);

assert.sameValue(new C().constructor, Array);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/construct/trap-is-undefined-proto-from-cross-realm-newtarget.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");

var P = new Proxy(function() {}, {});
var p = Reflect.construct(P, [], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(p), C.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/construct/trap-is-undefined-proto-from-newtarget-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

var P = new Proxy(function() {}, {});
var p = Reflect.construct(P, [], C);

assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(p), other.Object.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/get-fn-realm-recursive.js
// Copyright (C) 2019 Aleksey Shvayka. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var realm1 = $262.createRealm().global;
var realm2 = $262.createRealm().global;
var realm3 = $262.createRealm().global;
var realm4 = $262.createRealm().global;

var newTarget = realm1.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
newTarget.prototype = null;

var newTargetProxy = new realm2.Proxy(newTarget, {});
var newTargetProxyProxy = new realm3.Proxy(newTargetProxy, {});
var boolean = Reflect.construct(realm4.Boolean, [], newTargetProxyProxy);

assert(boolean instanceof realm1.Boolean);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(boolean), realm1.Boolean.prototype);
})();

// Replacement for test/built-ins/Proxy/get-fn-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var realm1 = $262.createRealm().global;
var realm2 = $262.createRealm().global;
var realm3 = $262.createRealm().global;

var newTarget = realm1.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
newTarget.prototype = false;

var newTargetProxy = new realm2.Proxy(newTarget, {});
var array = Reflect.construct(realm3.Array, [], newTargetProxy);

assert(array instanceof realm1.Array);
assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(array), realm1.Array.prototype);
})();

console.log("DS19 proxy complete");
